output.reason: The brief convincingly clears the operators: printer logs show no overrides, the error starts on 4 Oct right after a future-dated 36-month ERP value was entered, and it also hit permanent day-shift staff. The steps are clear, but it leaves open why PackBridge read the future value, and it limits the hold to lots from 4 Oct even though the QA manager warned the problem may have started earlier.
